title: Starter Kit for Testing Agentic Systems for Safety and Reliability
headline: Starter Kit for Testing Agentic Systems for Safety and Reliability
summary: The AI Verify Foundation published a framework providing guidance to organisations on deploying AI agents responsibly while maintaining human accountability. The framework includes a structured overview of agentic AI risks and emerging management practices, updated with real-world case studies in May 2026.
why_it_matters: Organisations deploying agentic AI systems must establish robust testing and safety controls while ensuring humans remain ultimately accountable for the system's actions.

quotes.text: This framework provides guidance to organisations on how to deploy AI agents responsibly, while emphasising that humans are ultimately accountable.
It gives organisations a structured overview of the risks of agentic AI and emerging best practices in managing these risks.

classification.significance_reason: Provides practical guidance and case studies for testing agentic AI systems, though it is voluntary guidance from an international foundation.
